author: Amanjeet Singh
status: Bounded diagnostic follow-up informed by the retained US results
reason: The prespecified origin exclusion gives a more precise C36 response; the full-sample result is sensitive to long policy history and leverage. Cross those two concerns with the exclusion and test the correlated sample difference, without replacing the primary.

coefficient_contrast.name: outside_episode_minus_full_sample
coefficient_contrast.designs: Retained primary 42-column design and retained prespecified 42-column origin-excluded design
coefficient_contrast.covariance: Embed each design coefficient score on the original 238 event rows, using zero only for deliberately excluded rows. Multiply each design score by sqrt(n/(n-k)), sum within calendar month and apply the same 41-month Bartlett kernel to the joint two-column scores.
coefficient_contrast.variance: V_subset+V_full-2*Cov_subset_full; do not compare separate significance labels

inference: Pointwise 95 intervals and an additional Bonferroni .05/3 family across the two crossed durable C36 checks and the sample coefficient contrast
prohibited_changes: No replacement primary, new shock window, instrument, category, horizon or selected favourable lag. Earlier results retained unchanged.
interpretation: Excludes decision origins in the reserves-targeting episode; outcome follow-up and prior policy histories can still cross it. A significant secondary response is not itself a significant period contrast. The follow-up is informed, not prospectively unobserved.
